name: Zumper
description: Zumper is a rental listing marketplace that connects renters with landlords and property managers across the United States and Canada. The platform provides access to apartment listings, property data, rental price insights, and tenant application management.

hasOfferCatalog.name: Zumper API
hasOfferCatalog.description: The Zumper API provides access to rental listings, property data, rental price insights, and tenant application management. Partners and property management software providers can use the API to syndicate listings to Zumper, retrieve rental market intelligence, access tenant screening powered by TransUnion, and manage leasing workflows.

itemListElement.name: Listing Syndication
itemListElement.description: Publish and syndicate rental listings to Zumper's marketplace and partner networks including PadMapper, ChatGPT, Microsoft Bing, and Realtor.com.

itemListElement.name: Rental Market Data
itemListElement.description: Access rental price insights and market intelligence data via the Zumper API.

itemListElement.name: Tenant Screening
itemListElement.description: Tenant screening powered by TransUnion integrated into the leasing workflow.

itemListElement.name: PowerLeads AI
itemListElement.description: Lead management and AI-powered leasing workflows via Zumper's PowerLeads engine.
